description.short: Weekly outdoor farmers market featuring local vendors.
description.long: Join us every Saturday morning at Riverside Plaza for the Downtown Farmers Market. Browse fresh produce, homemade goods, live music, and activities for kids. Over 40 local vendors participate each week.

where.parking_info: Free street parking available on Main St and Oak Ave.

description.short: Monthly food truck gathering at Lowe Mill featuring 20+ trucks and live music.
description.long: Every first Friday of the month, Lowe Mill ARTS & Entertainment hosts Food Truck Friday. Over 20 local and regional food trucks line up alongside live music on the outdoor stage. Family-friendly, dog-friendly, and free to attend â€” just bring your appetite and cash for the trucks.

where.parking_info: Free parking in the Lowe Mill lot and along Seminole Dr.

audience.accessibility: Partially accessible, some uneven outdoor surfaces
audience.requirements: Cash or card for food purchases

events.title: Huntsville Astronomy Club Monthly Stargazing Night

description.short: Free public stargazing event hosted by the Von Braun Astronomical Society.
description.long: The Von Braun Astronomical Society hosts free public stargazing nights at the Burritt on the Mountain observatory. Bring the family and peer through telescopes operated by club members. Topics this month include Saturn's rings and deep-sky objects in the summer sky. No experience needed.

where.parking_info: Free parking on site. Drive up the mountain road to the main lot.

audience.requirements: Red flashlight recommended, no white lights near telescopes

description.short: Annual 5K run and walk through downtown Huntsville benefiting local youth programs.
description.long: Lace up your shoes for the Rocket City 5K! This annual event winds through the heart of downtown Huntsville past landmarks like Big Spring Park and the U.S. Space & Rocket Center. All proceeds benefit Huntsville youth athletic programs. Medals for top finishers in each age group. Post-race celebration with food and music.

where.parking_info: Parking decks available on Clinton Ave and Holmes Ave. Arrive early.

audience.requirements: Registered participants only. Bib pickup day-of starting at 6:30am.

description.short: Monthly meetup for Python developers and data science enthusiasts in the Tennessee Valley.
description.long: The Huntsville Python & Data Science Meetup brings together developers, analysts, students, and hobbyists to share projects, learn new tools, and network. This month's talk: 'Intro to LLM APIs with Python' by a local engineer from Redstone Arsenal's tech community. Pizza provided. All skill levels welcome.

where.parking_info: Free street parking on Franklin St after 6pm.

description.short: Three-day outdoor arts festival at Big Spring Park featuring 100+ artists, live performances, and hands-on activities.
description.long: Panoply Arts Festival is Huntsville's premier outdoor arts celebration, held annually at Big Spring International Park. Over 100 juried artists display and sell original work across all media â€” painting, sculpture, photography, ceramics, and more. Live music on two stages, dance performances, food vendors, and a children's art activity area make this a beloved community tradition.

where.parking_info: Paid parking in downtown decks. Shuttle service from Huntsville Botanical Garden on Saturday.

attendance.cost: $10/day or $20 weekend pass; children under 12 free

audience.requirements: Tickets available at the gate or online

description.short: Annual celebration of making, tinkering, and DIY innovation at the U.S. Space & Rocket Center.
description.long: Huntsville Maker Faire brings together makers, hackers, crafters, engineers, and inventors for a full day of demos, workshops, and hands-on fun at the U.S. Space & Rocket Center. Exhibits range from robotics and 3D printing to textile art and amateur radio. A must-attend for curious minds of all ages in the Rocket City.

where.parking_info: Free parking on site in the main Space & Rocket Center lot.

audience.requirements: Tickets recommended in advance, limited day-of availability

description.short: Outdoor summer pops concert by the Huntsville Symphony Orchestra at Big Spring Park.
description.long: The Huntsville Symphony Orchestra presents its annual Summer Pops concert under the stars at Big Spring International Park. Bring a blanket or lawn chair and enjoy an evening of crowd-pleasing orchestral favorites, film scores, and American classics. Concessions available on site.

where.parking_info: Paid parking in downtown decks on Clinton Ave and Holmes Ave.

audience.requirements: Bring lawn chairs or blankets; no outside alcohol

description.short: Weekly drop-in board game night at Phat Sammies in downtown Huntsville.
description.long: Every Thursday night, Phat Sammies hosts an open board game night. Bring your own games or borrow from the house library of 100+ titles. Great for solo players looking for a group, couples, or groups of friends. No signup needed â€” just show up, order some food, and roll the dice.

where.parking_info: Free parking in the strip mall lot.

description.short: Evening garden walk featuring illuminated trails and blooming night flowers at Huntsville Botanical Garden.
description.long: Night Blooms transforms the Huntsville Botanical Garden into a glowing wonderland after dark. Stroll illuminated pathways through seasonal flowers, specialty gardens, and the butterfly house. Live acoustic music, food vendors, and a beer garden round out the experience. A perfect date night or family outing.

where.parking_info: Free on-site parking in the main garden lot.

audience.requirements: Tickets must be purchased in advance

description.short: Annual craft beer festival showcasing 40+ regional breweries at Campus 805.
description.long: The Tennessee Valley Brew Fest returns to Campus 805 for a full afternoon of craft beer sampling, live music, and local food vendors. Over 40 regional breweries pour their best IPAs, stouts, sours, and seasonal releases. VIP early entry available. Proceeds support the local veterans community.

where.parking_info: Street parking on Madison St; overflow at nearby public lots.

audience.requirements: Valid ID required. No outside beverages.

events.title: Huntsville Trail Runners Weekend Group Run

description.short: Weekly group trail run at Monte Sano State Park open to all skill levels.
description.long: Join the Huntsville Trail Runners every Saturday morning for a group run on the trails of Monte Sano State Park. Routes range from 3 to 10 miles depending on group preference. Beginners welcome â€” no one gets left behind. Meet at the trailhead parking lot. Post-run coffee at a nearby cafe.

where.parking_info: $5 state park day-use fee per vehicle.

description.short: Annual pop culture convention at the Von Braun Center featuring cosplay, vendors, and celebrity guests.
description.long: Rocket City Comic Con takes over the Von Braun Center for a weekend packed with pop culture. Cosplay contests, artist alley, tabletop gaming, panels with celebrity guests from TV and film, and hundreds of vendor tables. Whether you're into comics, anime, sci-fi, or fantasy â€” there's something for every fan.

where.parking_info: Paid parking in the VBC garage on Monroe St. $10/day.

attendance.cost: $20/day or $35 weekend pass; children under 10 free

audience.requirements: No real weapons; prop weapons must be peace-bonded at entry

description.short: 54-hour startup competition where teams build and pitch new business ideas over a weekend.
description.long: Startup Weekend Huntsville challenges entrepreneurs, developers, designers, and business minds to form teams, validate ideas, and build a startup pitch in just 54 hours. Mentors from the Huntsville tech and business community guide teams throughout the weekend. Top teams pitch to a panel of judges on Sunday evening for prizes and recognition.

where.parking_info: Free street parking on Franklin St evenings and weekends.

events.title: Ditto's Music Hall: Local Band Showcase

description.short: Live showcase featuring four up-and-coming local Huntsville bands at Ditto's Music Hall.
description.long: Ditto's Music Hall presents a local band showcase spotlighting the best emerging talent in the Huntsville music scene. Four bands spanning rock, blues, and indie will take the stage for back-to-back sets. $5 cover goes directly to the artists. Drinks and bites available at the bar. Doors open at 7pm.

where.parking_info: Free parking in the Ditto's lot.

description.short: Volunteer neighborhood clean-up event organized through r/HuntsvilleAlabama covering multiple districts.
description.long: Organized by volunteers from the r/HuntsvilleAlabama subreddit, this bi-annual community clean-up brings dozens of residents together to pick up litter, clear overgrown trail edges, and beautify public spaces across multiple neighborhoods. Supplies provided. Come for an hour or the whole day â€” every bit helps.

where.room: Meet at Five Points neighborhood park
where.parking_info: Street parking at designated meet-up locations.

audience.dress_code: Wear clothes you don't mind getting dirty
audience.requirements: Gloves and bags provided; bring water

description.short: One-day family experience at the U.S. Space & Rocket Center with hands-on space science activities.
description.long: Family Space Day at the U.S. Space & Rocket Center gives families a taste of Space Camp with guided STEM activities, rocket building, astronaut training simulators, and a tour of the Saturn V rocket. Staff-led sessions run throughout the day. Perfect for kids interested in science, technology, and space exploration.

audience.dress_code: Casual, closed-toe shoes required for simulators
